baslik: TV Words in Focus: Plurals, the News and Who Makes a Program
paragraflar: TV Words and Plurals: Çoğu kelime -s alır (channels, commercials), sessiz harf + y ile bitenler -ies alır (documentaries); series tekil ve çoğulda aynıdır, news sayılamaz ve tekil fiil alır: The news is on at 8 p.m.
Excitement and Feelings: Sabırsızlık I can't wait for + isim ya da I can't wait to + fiil ile anlatılır; enjoy / love / hate / don't mind fiillerinden sonra V-ing gelir: I enjoy watching quiz shows.
